sources.title: Angola Ministry of External Relations: National Ordinary Passport
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of Angola in Italy, Ministry of External Relations
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Angola MIREX embassy service page expressly identifies the National Ordinary Passport as the official document enabling Angolan citizens to cross international borders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: O Passaporte Nacional Ordinário é o documento oficial de identificação e de viagem ... atravessar fronteiras internacionais.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: Regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal gives tourist-entry rules, identifies the visa-exempt Chinese-citizen exception and directs other visitors to the eVisaCuba electronic tourist-visa process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory to enter Cuba if you do not have Cuban residency.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal identifies SNEDAI as the only visa-application website officially recognised and approved by the State of Côte d'Ivoire, and limits the route to valid ordinary passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement à l'aéroport d'Abidjan.

policies.title: Angolan ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Angolan visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available from anywhere except the United States.
conditions: Use a valid Angolan National Ordinary Passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; an Angolan ordinary-passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate. The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Angolan National Ordinary Passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Angolan ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official valid-ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: The route applies to a valid Angolan National Ordinary Passport. Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the valid Angolan National Ordinary Passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

conflicts.explanation: The official valid-ordinary-passport process requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport. Angola's MIREX source establishes the ordinary national passport's international-travel scope.
